text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*Clap clap!* Praying for victory in the 
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...let us refrain from doing that. This is 
something I must accomplish with my own 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
God can just watch this time. I'll handle 
it myself. Now then, for my other wish...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Huh-huh? Huhuuhhh~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we have a huge problem! I don't 
have any wishes to make!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"For fortune-telling's favored child, of 
all people—namely, myself— to fall into a 
situation where I have nothing to wish 
for!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Well~, I just couldn't think of anything. 
Good bonds and the dreams I'm chasing—I 
already have all of them right now!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Has something inside me withered away? The 
craving that leads to devotion!
choice_data_list:
Doesn't that mean they're completely 
content?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Am I satisfied? I certainly am content, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! You're already so happy 
that you don't have anything to wish for.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... How wonderful, yet utterly grave. 
To have nothing left to pray for before 
the altar...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'd at least, at least like to wrap things 
up on a crisp note, but...

We came to the shrine together, but in the 
end, Matikane Fukukitaru couldn't come up 
with anything.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Good grief~ This just won't do at all. Not 
being able to perform the ritual before 
the decisive battle...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Too much happiness is as bad as too 
little, isn't it? Is there anything you 
wish for besides victory...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Everyone's happiness...? Not mine?

I talked about the journey so far. About 
the people who supported 
Matikanefukukitaru on her way here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Thanks to everyone, I've found 
happiness. Yet, I haven't been able to 
repay the favor.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Now it's my turn to bring happiness to 
everyone! Once my own wish comes true, 
it's time for everyone else's!"

Her expression was magnificent and 
composed. Like a maiden born beloved by 
gods and buddhas.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If I win the Arima Kinen, will everyone 
be happy?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case... instead of a 
wish, I'll make it something else.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, asking for favors 
isn't the only thing you can do before 
God, is it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just imitating what I saw, but—let's 
do that! Today of all days is the perfect 
day for it."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hear my vow! O Goddess Shiraoki, 
enshrined upon this sacred altar. Please, 
receive my oath!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely win the Arima Kinen! To 
deliver happiness to the ones who gave me 
my pride.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: With utmost awe and reverence—I speak!

A dignified voice echoes across the 
December sky. Her solemn oath was nothing 
short of divine.

Only a short time left—until the Arima 
Kinen.
